T01.title: Ordinary key/value trees
T01.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-07.

**Declare/do:** Declare a contract-owned ordinary collection; create/read/insert/replace/delete through typed host handles.

**Rules/checks:** NormalTree and Item. Namespace, allowed value types and key codec must be fixed; reject forged paths and non-empty subtree replacement. Verify inclusion and absence.

**Cost drivers:** Key/value bytes, depth, affected ancestors. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24)

T02.title: Signed sum trees
T02.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-07.

**Declare/do:** Declare a summed integer contribution; host maintains SumItem or ItemWithSumItem on writes; expose total.

**Rules/checks:** SumTree. Checked signed arithmetic; changing a value removes its old contribution and adds its new one. Whole-tree totals do not imply logarithmic range-sum proofs.

**Cost drivers:** Integer width, write fan-out, ancestors. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24)

T03.title: Large sum trees
T03.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-07.

**Declare/do:** Declare BigSumTree when wider totals are needed; expose exact integer encoding.

**Rules/checks:** BigSumTree uses a 256-bit aggregate, not a new unrestricted monetary supply type. Verify overflow and client lossless conversion; no automatic range-sum proof promise.

**Cost drivers:** Large-integer arithmetic and encoding bytes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24)

T04.title: Count trees
T04.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Declare countable documents/indexes; insert/delete maintain count; read total.

**Rules/checks:** CountTree counts contributions, which may be subtree counts rather than one per returned row. Test nested trees, empty branches and non-counted continuations.

**Cost drivers:** Changed branches and query traversal. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24); [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs#L1)

T05.title: Combined count/sum trees
T05.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04, CAP-18.

**Declare/do:** Declare both countability and a required integer sum field; maintain both with each document mutation.

**Rules/checks:** CountSumTree; return count and sum from the same view. Update of only the summed field leaves count unchanged. Reject overflow atomically.

**Cost drivers:** Both aggregates and every affected index. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24); [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs#L1)

T06.title: Provable count trees
T06.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Declare range countability; support authenticated range counts and eligible offset queries.

**Rules/checks:** ProvableCountTree binds counts in the hash. Prove requested boundaries, empty ranges and page offsets; reject offset shapes where a row contributes multiple count units.

**Cost drivers:** Boundary traversal, proof bytes and skipped-count checks. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24); [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs#L1)

T07.title: Provable count with ordinary sum
T07.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Preserve this distinct layout where selected by the native dispatcher.

**Rules/checks:** ProvableCountSumTree proves count ranges; it is not the variant that commits both range aggregates. Never label its sum as a compact authenticated range sum.

**Cost drivers:** Count proof plus ordinary sum maintenance. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24); [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs#L1)

T08.title: Provable sum trees
T08.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Declare rangeSummable with its required summable field; read authenticated signed sums.

**Rules/checks:** ProvableSumTree binds sum values. Test negative values, cancellation, ranges and overflow; reuse the exact native validator and proof consumer.

**Cost drivers:** Boundary traversal, arithmetic and proof bytes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24); [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs#L1)

T09.title: Provable count and provable sum trees
T09.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Declare both range metrics; expose a single count/sum result and derive averages outside consensus arithmetic.

**Rules/checks:** ProvableCountProvableSumTree supports a proof binding both. Empty count has no numeric average; specify client representation and rounding if displayed.

**Cost drivers:** Dual aggregate proof and maintenance. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24); [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/primary_key_tree_type.rs#L1)

T10.title: Count-ranked trees
T10.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Declare ranked count indexes; query top/bottom groups, bounds and rank where supported.

**Rules/checks:** ProvableCountIndexedTree maintains a secondary Count axis. Every primary change must update the secondary; test nested indexed trees and ties.

**Cost drivers:** Primary plus secondary writes and requested page size. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24); [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/ranked_index_tree_type.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/ranked_index_tree_type.rs#L1)

T11.title: Sum-ranked trees
T11.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Declare ranked sum indexes; query groups ordered by their aggregate sum.

**Rules/checks:** ProvableSumIndexedTree maintains a Sum axis; test sign, ties, moved ranking position, deletion and tampered secondary proofs.

**Cost drivers:** Secondary reordering and aggregate proof size. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24); [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/ranked_index_tree_type.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/ranked_index_tree_type.rs#L1)

T12.title: Multiple aggregate ranking axes
T12.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-04.

**Declare/do:** Declare the selected Count/Sum/Avg axes and use axis-specific typed queries.

**Rules/checks:** ProvableCountProvableSumIndexedTree needs explicit axes, not just TreeType. Test canonical axis order, missing axes, exact average ordering and all secondary updates.

**Cost drivers:** Number of configured axes and moved entries. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/merk/src/tree_type/mod.rs#L24); [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/ranked_index_tree_type.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/ranked_index_tree_type.rs#L1)

T13.title: Commitment trees
T13.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-07.

**Declare/do:** Declare chunk configuration; append validated commitments and typed payloads; read count, values/ranges and anchor.

**Rules/checks:** CommitmentTree. Native commitment/field validation and append semantics remain mandatory. Current-root membership is separate from future general ZK contract execution.

**Cost drivers:** Commitment hashing, encrypted payload bytes and tree growth. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/operations/commitment_tree.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/operations/commitment_tree.rs#L1)

T14.title: Merkle mountain ranges
T14.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-07.

**Declare/do:** Declare an append-only sequence; append, read leaves/count/root and expose supported proofs.

**Rules/checks:** MmrTree. No arbitrary leaf edits. Test append boundaries, peaks and empty sequence; bind the returned root through the enclosing current Platform root.

**Cost drivers:** Append hashing, peaks and value/proof bytes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/operations/mmr_tree.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/operations/mmr_tree.rs#L1)

T15.title: Bulk append trees
T15.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-07.

**Declare/do:** Declare chunk power; append and read positions, ranges, chunks, buffer and counts.

**Rules/checks:** BulkAppendTree. Test buffer-to-chunk rollover, range boundaries, ordered positions and deletion policy; chunk reads need the matching proof shape.

**Cost drivers:** Buffer flushes, chunks touched and result bytes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/operations/bulk_append_tree.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/operations/bulk_append_tree.rs#L1)

T16.title: Dense fixed-size append trees
T16.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-07.

**Declare/do:** Declare height/capacity and value shape; append/read position/count/root.

**Rules/checks:** DenseAppendOnlyFixedSizeTree. Enforce native shape and capacity; full-tree insertion fails without partial changes. Do not offer arbitrary positional replacement.

**Cost drivers:** Fixed tree growth, value bytes and proof path. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/operations/dense_tree.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/operations/dense_tree.rs#L1)

T17.title: Private document stores
T17.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-07.

**Declare/do:** Declare chunk power AND entry size; append exactly sized entries; read positions/count via a typed store handle.

**Rules/checks:** PrivateDocumentStore. Native entry-size and configuration validation must run. Storage type alone does not keep data secret from validators executing guest code; privacy access/encoding is an open interface choice.

**Cost drivers:** Entry size, chunk flush and proof/response bytes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/operations/private_document_store.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/operations/private_document_store.rs#L1)

## Elements

E01.title: Items carrying sum contributions
E01.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-03, CAP-17.

**Declare/do:** Drive constructs Item, SumItem and ItemWithSumItem from validated document/balance data.

**Rules/checks:** Payload and contribution must agree; guest-supplied totals are not trusted. Preserve flags and value codecs through replacement, serialization and proofs.

**Cost drivers:** Payload and contribution encoding. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb-element/src/element/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb-element/src/element/mod.rs#L60)

E02.title: Contribution exclusion wrappers
E02.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-03, CAP-17.

**Declare/do:** Drive selects NonCounted, NotSummed or NotCountedOrSummed for structural branches.

**Rules/checks:** Exclude only the intended axes. Test nesting, index continuations, replace/move/delete and root propagation; guest cannot hide holdings from conservation totals.

**Cost drivers:** Wrapped element size and propagation. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb-element/src/element/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb-element/src/element/mod.rs#L60)

## References

R01.title: Ordinary references and seven path forms
R01.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-06.

**Declare/do:** Declare permitted relations; resolve through bounded handles. Cover absolute, root-relative, parent-addition, element-relative, cousin, removed-cousin and sibling references.

**Rules/checks:** Validate resolved target namespace, hop limits, cycles, dangling targets and proofs. A relative path is not a permission grant. Ordinary references need explicit maintenance when targets change.

**Cost drivers:** Hops, path bytes, target reads and rewrites. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb-element/src/reference_path/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb-element/src/reference_path/mod.rs#L18)

R02.title: References carrying sum contributions
R02.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-06.

**Declare/do:** Drive maintains ReferenceWithSumItem for indexes and supported typed relations.

**Rules/checks:** Recompute contribution from validated data; refresh target hashes on edits. Test changed target, same-batch moves and aggregate correctness.

**Cost drivers:** Reference hops plus sum/index update work. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb-element/src/element/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb-element/src/element/mod.rs#L60)

R03.title: Bidirectional references
R03.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-06.

**Declare/do:** Declare automatic incoming-reference maintenance, capacity and cascade consent; offer only consistently flagged host mutations.

**Rules/checks:** GROVE_V4 feature. Target must support backrefs; max incoming <=256, native default32, depth<=32, chains<=10 and one incoming per reference. These are native bounds, not approved guest defaults. Enforce cross-contract consent for every derived write.

**Cost drivers:** Declared fan-out times chain/depth work, including registration and cleanup. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [adr/bidirectional_references.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/adr/bidirectional_references.md#L1)

R04.title: Back-reference targets and cascades
R04.body:
**Surface:** Capability included; contract interface choice open. **Tasks:** CAP-02, CAP-06.

**Declare/do:** Support ItemWithBackwardsReferences, SumItemWithBackwardsReferences and ItemWithSumItemWithBackwardsReferences through the same relation declaration.

**Rules/checks:** No aggregate wrappers; Provable aggregate parents and V0 proofs reject this family. Every affected edge must consent to destructive cascade. Capacity cannot drop below registrations. Never accept raw incoming lists from guest code.

**Cost drivers:** Target growth, cascade deletes and refund owners. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [adr/bidirectional_references.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/adr/bidirectional_references.md#L1)

R05.title: Back-reference batch and lifecycle constraints
R05.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-06, CAP-14.

**Declare/do:** Select the native flagged full-batch path or validated live operation; keep incompatible clear/partial-batch operations out of this route.

**Rules/checks:** Partial batches and clear lack propagation support. Flagged batch refuses non-empty subtree deletion; flagged insert/delete rejects specialized/indexed trees. Unflagged overwrite/delete can break links, so prevent that escape route including wipe/migration. Test same-batch targets, conflicts and rollback.

**Cost drivers:** Expanded derived operations and worst-case bounds. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [adr/bidirectional_references.md](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/adr/bidirectional_references.md#L1)

## Documents

D01.title: Contract schema and configuration
D01.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-03.

**Declare/do:** Create/update data contract schemas with native DPP validation and protocol selection.

**Rules/checks:** Honor readonly, deletion, history defaults, sized integers and key requirements; distinguish data-contract history settings from permanent WASM code retention. Reject incompatible updates.

**Cost drivers:** Schema bytes, validation and affected storage layout. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/config/v1/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/config/v1/mod.rs#L21)

D02.title: Document properties and serialization
D02.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-03.

**Declare/do:** Declare typed/required/transient properties and canonical system fields; build typed values in guest/client SDKs.

**Rules/checks:** Use existing schema and property validators, identifiers/binary paths and serializers. Test nested values, integer limits, required-since rules and stored versus guest-wire expansion.

**Cost drivers:** Decoded/encoded bytes, nesting and property count. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/document_type/v2/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/document_type/v2/mod.rs#L30)

D03.title: Document creation
D03.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-03.

**Declare/do:** Create documents only through permitted contract/native actions.

**Rules/checks:** Validate IDs, entropy/nonce, owner, timestamps, required fields and schema. Contract-only authorization is new work; it cannot be assumed from OwnerOnly. Insert primary, indexes and history atomically.

**Cost drivers:** Primary plus every index/history write. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/insert/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/insert/mod.rs#L1)

D04.title: Document replacement
D04.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-03.

**Declare/do:** Replace a mutable document under its contract rules and native revision checks.

**Rules/checks:** Remove old index contributions and add new ones; preserve owner/refund rules and immutable fields. Test change of indexed field or sum only, stale revision and failure rollback.

**Cost drivers:** Old/new bytes and removed/inserted index paths. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/update/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/update/mod.rs#L1)

D05.title: Document deletion and branch cleanup
D05.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-03.

**Declare/do:** Delete when allowed, removing primary/index entries and empty structural branches.

**Rules/checks:** Honor can-delete, ownership and history. Generic delete cannot erase permanent code or bypass wipe rules. Count/sum/ranked structures must remain coherent.

**Cost drivers:** Removed bytes, history, cleanup and refunds. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/delete/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/document/delete/mod.rs#L1)

D06.title: Document transfers
D06.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-03.

**Declare/do:** Transfer holdings using contract authority and native transferability rules.

**Rules/checks:** Validate sender/recipient, security level, revision and contract restrictions; update owner indexes and configured transfer history. A contract is not an identity.

**Cost drivers:** Ownership/index changes and history bytes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/state_transition_action/batch/batched_transition/document_transition/document_transition_action_type.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/state_transition_action/batch/batched_transition/document_transition/document_transition_action_type.rs#L1)

D07.title: Document price updates and purchases
D07.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-03.

**Declare/do:** Expose native price-update and purchase actions through permitted methods.

**Rules/checks:** Bind expected chain root, path, full request, effective limit and result type. Subset reuse is not universally valid; missing receipts do not prove execution outcome.

## Atomic operations and costs

A01.title: Atomic full batches and transaction ownership
A01.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Apply validated contract/native effects through existing GroveDB batches and the owning Platform transaction.

**Rules/checks:** Test primary/index/assets/history/receipts all-or-nothing on failure, nested calls and mixed native work. One atomic GroveDB call does not by itself specify nested contract rollback.

**Cost drivers:** Whole expanded batch and transaction memory. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs#L312)

A02.title: Insert-only, upsert, replace and patch
A02.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Expose operation intent through validated document/collection methods.

**Rules/checks:** Native InsertIfNotExists can error or skip; preserve distinction. Known-not-existing hints, byte-change hints and trusted payloads are supplied only by Drive after validation.

**Cost drivers:** Existence checks, old/new bytes and patch accounting. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs#L312)

A03.title: Delete, subtree deletion and clearing
A03.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Provide permitted delete/clear intent with fixed host-owned deletion policy.

**Rules/checks:** Account for every descendant and refund owner; reject non-empty deletion when unsupported. DontCheckWithNoCleanup and DropFlat cannot become guest-selected accounting bypasses.

**Cost drivers:** Subtree size, cleanup, references and refunded bytes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs#L312)

A04.title: Move and query-selected batch operations
A04.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Support native moves and bounded query-selected move/delete through typed authorized objects.

**Rules/checks:** Authorize both source and destination; preserve flags/index references and ownership. Test collisions, overlapping selections, same-batch reads and all-or-nothing effects.

**Cost drivers:** Selected rows, both paths and dependent index/reference work. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/util/grove_operations/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/util/grove_operations/mod.rs#L1)

A05.title: Conditional insertion and arithmetic helpers
A05.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Reuse if-changed, if-absent, return-existing and sum-item add/keep-item helpers for appropriate host intents.

**Rules/checks:** Guests cannot skip native affordability or overwrite contributions arbitrarily. Test existing/wrong-type entries, zero deltas, arithmetic overflow and operation ordering.

**Cost drivers:** Reads, changed bytes and arithmetic propagation. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/util/grove_operations/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/util/grove_operations/mod.rs#L1)

A06.title: Reference refresh modes
A06.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Drive chooses plain/sum reference refresh and trusted/untrusted mode after validated index planning.

**Rules/checks:** Preserve flags, path, wrapper and sum according to mode; trusted coercion is not a public guest option. RefreshReference on bidirectional participants must reject.

**Cost drivers:** Hop resolution and rewritten hashes/contributions. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs#L312)

A07.title: Partial batches and callback merging
A07.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Reuse only where native integration requires partial batches and cost callbacks.

**Rules/checks:** V4 merges/rejects callback collisions with pending ancestor updates. Test each tree family, cross-segment conflicts and old-version replay; backrefs have no partial expansion support.

**Cost drivers:** Both segments, callbacks and pending propagation. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs#L312)

A08.title: Internal root propagation and secondary reconciliation
A08.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-10, CAP-17.

**Declare/do:** Keep all root/hash replacement and aggregate-index secondary operations internal.

**Rules/checks:** Seven root/family propagation GroveOp variants are never guest requests. Test nested indexed changes and metadata retention; guest cannot forge root hashes.

**Cost drivers:** Ancestor paths, every secondary and specialized metadata. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/batch/mod.rs#L312)

A09.title: Batch consistency and host-owned options
A09.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-10.

**Declare/do:** Fix validation/propagation options in the protocol-selected host path.

**Rules/checks:** Keep duplicate/conflicting operation checks enabled; do not expose disable_consistency_check, free-root billing or pause height to guests. Include derived cascade conflicts.

**Cost drivers:** Validation of expanded operations and conflict lookups. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [grovedb/src/batch/options.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/grovedb/src/batch/options.rs#L12)

A10.title: Cost estimation, charging and storage refunds
A10.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-11.

**Declare/do:** Use existing average/worst-case/actual native costs plus metered guest work; signer pays direct calls and stored owner receives refunds.

**Rules/checks:** Full bound checked against live funds; actual charged once on success or paid failure. Reconcile hash/seek/load/add/replace/remove and history/reference/specialized work. Fee registry fix precedes infrastructure merges.

**Cost drivers:** Every native OperationCost dimension plus compute and wire copies. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/fees/op.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/fees/op.rs#L1)

A11.title: Storage flags and ownership epochs
A11.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-11.

**Declare/do:** Drive constructs and updates storage ownership/epoch flags and split refunds.

**Rules/checks:** Preserve old-owner historical refunds across edits/moves/wipes; no guest-supplied flags. Test shared flags, shrink/grow, epoch transitions and compound cascades.

**Cost drivers:** Flag bytes, removed-byte attribution and epoch accounting. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/util/storage_flags.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/util/storage_flags.rs#L1)

A12.title: Protocol dispatch and GroveDB upgrade
A12.body:
**Surface:** Drive/node internal; no raw guest API. **Tasks:** CAP-01, CAP-15.

**Declare/do:** Integrate the reviewed develop snapshot with explicit PlatformVersion-to-GroveVersion maps and dependency/codec compatibility.

**Rules/checks:** Platform currently pins 6fc7e1e; develop is c401b504, workspace6.0.0 and bincode2.1.0. Grove V4 is not Platform PV4. Preserve old roots/cost behavior and reject new forms before activation.

**Cost drivers:** Upgrade migration, historical replay and new cost tables. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/Cargo.toml](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/Cargo.toml#L55); [Cargo.toml](https://github.com/dashpay/grovedb/blob/c401b504f392d04e6782da8865fdb6e760b66741/Cargo.toml#L1)

N01.title: Identity lookup, keys and nonces
N01.body:
**Surface:** Existing native route; contract authority constrained. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Use identity/key/contract-info queries for caller authorization and existing signed identity operations.

**Rules/checks:** Guest cannot mint identities, forge keys or bump nonces arbitrarily. Contract holdings remain separate; test replay, disabled keys, security levels and contract-specific nonce checks.

**Cost drivers:** Key/nonce/contract-info reads and native writes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

N02.title: Identity credit balances and transfers
N02.body:
**Surface:** Existing native route; contract authority constrained. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Reuse authorized native balance reads/transfers as the adapter basis for contract deposits/payouts.

**Rules/checks:** Use checked amounts and live affordability; honor recipient contract rules and atomic conservation. Identity debit requires its authorization, never mere visibility.

**Cost drivers:** Balance reads/writes and conservation updates. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/identity/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/identity/mod.rs#L1)

N03.body:
**Surface:** New contract integration already selected. **Tasks:** CAP-08, CAP-14.

**Declare/do:** Add separate contract credit sum-tree buckets, spending rules and current-state queries/proofs.

**Rules/checks:** No keyless ordinary contract identity. Include zero/nonzero buckets, multiple recipients, freeze and wipes; both contracts must permit cross-contract movement.

**Cost drivers:** Bucket, authorization and total-supply accounting. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

N04.title: Contract token buckets
N04.body:

**Declare/do:** Extend typed token balance ownership to contract buckets and their spending/receiving rules.

**Rules/checks:** Respect token restrictions and all supply totals. Wiped issued tokens cease to exist; foreign holdings move to the specified identity vestige.

**Cost drivers:** Token buckets, supply checks and lifecycle moves. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

N05.title: Asset-lock credits and partial consumption
N05.body:
**Surface:** Existing native route; contract authority constrained. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Retain native Core asset-lock validation, spent tracking and partial-use accounting.

**Rules/checks:** No arbitrary credit issuance or direct contract-to-Core unlock. Test duplicate/outpoint proofs, partial consumption and mixed batch conservation.

**Cost drivers:** Proof checks, spent records and remaining credit accounting. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/asset_lock/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/asset_lock/mod.rs#L1)

N06.title: Identity and address withdrawals
N06.body:
**Surface:** Existing native route; contract authority constrained. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Keep existing authorized identity/address withdrawal queues and limits.

**Rules/checks:** Contract direct Core unlock is excluded. Guest cannot enqueue unsigned withdrawals or bypass native rate/fee rules; existing recovery remains.

**Cost drivers:** Queue storage, fee selection and pool accounting. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/identity/withdrawals/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/identity/withdrawals/mod.rs#L1)

N07.title: Address balances, nonces and funding routes
N07.body:
**Surface:** Existing native route; contract authority constrained. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Account for existing address funding/transfers and identity creation/top-up routes in conservation and adapters.

**Rules/checks:** These native routes are not automatically new contract holdings. Explicitly reject unsupported contract-to-address routes until designed; preserve signatures/nonces.

**Cost drivers:** Address inputs/outputs, proof checks and balance writes. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/address_funds/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/address_funds/mod.rs#L1)

N08.title: Token definitions and supply
N08.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Use token conventions, base/max supply, metadata, destination and configuration validation.

**Rules/checks:** Contract rules compose with native token authorization; cannot bypass supply caps, decimal bounds or referenced group checks. Version configuration changes.

**Cost drivers:** Definition bytes, supply writes and validation. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/associated_token/token_configuration/v0/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-dpp/src/data_contract/associated_token/token_configuration/v0/mod.rs#L38)

N09.title: Token mint and mint-many
N09.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Expose authorized minting and native multi-recipient mint operations.

**Rules/checks:** Enforce manual mint rules, max supply, destination restrictions and frozen-receipt behavior; test atomic rollback across recipients.

**Cost drivers:** Recipients, balances, supply and history. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/mint_many/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/mint_many/mod.rs#L1)

N10.title: Token burn and destroy frozen funds
N10.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Expose authorized burn/destroy-frozen-funds intents.

**Rules/checks:** Distinguish normal holder burn from privileged destruction. Maintain supply and mandatory history; wipe destruction of all issued tokens is additional lifecycle work.

**Cost drivers:** Destroyed holdings, supply/history updates. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

N11.title: Token transfer and balance reads
N11.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Expose transfer/read/query with contract bucket adapters.

**Rules/checks:** Enforce pause/freeze and allow-transfer-to-frozen settings, sender/receiver rules and lossless amount encoding. Test multi-step same-batch conservation.

**Cost drivers:** Balances, restrictions and transfer history. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/transfer/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/transfer/mod.rs#L1)

N12.title: Token freeze, unfreeze and emergency state
N12.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Expose native authorized freeze/unfreeze and pause/emergency operations.

**Rules/checks:** Native token state and smart-contract execution freeze are separate checks. Frozen actions reject, with no bypass through other host methods.

**Cost drivers:** Status/balance writes and mandatory history. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

Source: [packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/freeze/mod.rs](https://github.com/dashpay/platform/blob/5f1e0ccdce265c6a01d18a1ecde0466195b04bf1/packages/rs-drive/src/drive/tokens/freeze/mod.rs#L1)

N13.title: Token direct purchase and pricing
N13.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Expose authorized price changes and direct purchases using native marketplace rules.

**Rules/checks:** Check exact pricing, supply, buyer affordability, payment destination and history. This does not select the deferred native auction project.

**Cost drivers:** Price lookup, mint/transfer, payment and history. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

N14.title: Token perpetual and programmed distribution
N14.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Reuse distribution definitions, reward moments/types/functions and native claim/release machinery.

**Rules/checks:** Preserve supported functions and epoch/time semantics; no wall-clock nondeterminism. Contract recurring calls use the separate agreed pay-as-executed model.

**Cost drivers:** Recipients, due releases, claims and scheduled processing. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

N15.title: Token histories and configuration changes
N15.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-08.

**Declare/do:** Expose existing history settings and permitted configuration mutations.

**Rules/checks:** Some native events always record history even when optional categories are disabled. Preserve change-control rules; receipt disable cannot suppress required token records.

**Cost drivers:** History documents/indexes and configuration validation. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

N16.title: Groups, action records and change control
N16.body:
**Surface:** Reuse through validated contract APIs. **Tasks:** CAP-09.

**Declare/do:** Use identity/group authorization, weighted members, required power and native accumulated group actions.

**Rules/checks:** No assumption that a contract can itself hold group membership; that is deferred. Prevent duplicate power, expired/unauthorized actions and unapproved rule changes.

**Cost drivers:** Members, signatures, votes and action records. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

N17.title: Contested-resource voting and queries
N17.body:

N18.title: DPNS and system contracts
N18.body:

**Rules/checks:** Contract-held names deferred. System schemas/root permissions cannot be changed by a generic tree API; group authorization is still allowed.

**Cost drivers:** System document/index lookup and native validation. Shared proof, SDK, lifecycle and acceptance requirements: COMMON-1.

N19.body:

N20.title: Credit pools and total conservation
N20.body:

**Rules/checks:** Wipe credits enter the current processing pool. Check mint/burn/withdrawal/shielded/address interactions, refunds and epoch transitions.

N21.title: Prefunded specialized balances
N21.body:

**Declare/do:** Reuse native prefunded-balance storage where appropriate for approved fees/removal costs.
